notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
Hey guys! Just wanted to drop a status update here as we're approaching the end of Q3 and I want to keep everyone in the loop as to what to expect.

All of the content has been added and I'm in the QA portion of development, meaning I'm finding and fixing bugs and making final game design adjustments. Since I'm a solo developer and I work a full time job, it's really difficult for me to set a release date just yet, but I'm expecting the game to be ready around the end of September at the earlier and into October at the latest. This is my first game release, so I appreciate your patience as I navigate this process!

I hope you guys are looking forward to the full release! I'll make another update once the release date has been set.

notes.title: Happy Steam Next Fest, where to leave feedback, etc.
notes.content:
Happy Steam Next Fest everyone! The demo is up! Thank you to everyone who stumbles upon this little game and tries it out, I hope you have fun!

To those who played the alpha playtest in 2022, here's a list of some things that have changed since then:
[list]
[*] The dungeon is now roguelite in nature and is made of a chain of single rooms. Progress is lost when you leave.
[*] No more leveling up; Stats are gained by cooking food with ingredients that can be found or purchased.
[*] The card upgrade system has been significantly revamped and cards are now more customizable.
[*] New cards and items!
[/list]
If you want to leave feedback for the demo, please feel free to do so in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2061850/discussions/0/]the Next Fest forum in Aria's community hub[/url]. All feedback helps me to improve the game, so it's greatly appreciated!

The demo will be up until Monday, July 3rd (1 week after the fest ends) to give people time to enjoy it.

Have a great Next Fest, everyone!

notes.title: Alpha playtest scheduled to begin 9/12/22, sign up today!
notes.content:
A playtest of the [b]Alpha[/b] version of Aria and the Crystal Kingdom will be available beginning 12pm EST on 9/12/22 and will end at 12pm EST on 10/3/22. Sign up today by clicking the Request Access button on the store page, and you'll be notified when you're added to the playtest once it begins.

Please feel free to leave feedback, ask questions, and report any bugs you encounter in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2146670/]Playtest Community Hub[/url]. I'll be monitoring periodically and answering any questions you may have.

[b]Please note[/b]: This is a very early Alpha build of the game and is missing key features, final sound and art, and may be buggy. This version features about an hour of gameplay of a shortened version of the first area, of which four more are planned to be added in the future.

Here's a list of features missing from the Alpha but are planned for the future:
[list]
[*] Animations for enemies, NPCs, backgrounds, and attacks in battle
[*] UI hover-overs for status effects and abilities
[*] Autosave
[*] Traps in dungeons
[*] Bestiary
[*] Sell items at the shop and break cards down for materials
[*] Town/Dungeon map in the main menu
[*] Settings menu
[*] Visual distinction for classes when equipped
[*] Improved sound effects
[/list]

Cheers!
